title: Subtree
description: An object describing tile, content, and child subtree availability, attributes, and properties.
gltf_detailedDescription: An object describing the availability of tiles and content in a subtree, as well as availability of children subtrees. May also store attributes and application-specific properties for available tiles and contents.

tileAvailability.description: The availability of tiles in the subtree.
tileAvailability.gltf_detailedDescription: The availability of tiles in the subtree. The availability bitstream is a 1D boolean array where tiles are ordered by their level in the subtree and Morton index within that level. A tile's availability is determined by a single bit, 1 meaning a tile exists at that spatial index, and 0 meaning it does not. The number of elements in the array is `(N^subtreeLevels - 1)/(N - 1)` where N is 4 for subdivision scheme `QUADTREE` and 8 for `OCTREE`. Availability may be stored in a buffer view or as a constant value that applies to all tiles. If a non-root tile's availability is 1 its parent tile's availability must also be 1. `tileAvailability.constant: 0` is disallowed, as subtrees must have at least one tile.

contentAvailability.description: The availability of contents in the subtree.

childSubtreeAvailability.gltf_detailedDescription: The availability of children subtrees. The availability bitstream is a 1D boolean array where subtrees are ordered by their Morton index in the level of the tree immediately below the bottom row of the subtree. A child subtree's availability is determined by a single bit, 1 meaning a subtree exists at that spatial index, and 0 meaning it does not. The number of elements in the array is `N^subtreeLevels` where N is 4 for subdivision scheme `QUADTREE` and 8 for `OCTREE`. Availability may be stored in a buffer view or as a constant value that applies to all child subtrees. If availability is 0 for all child subtrees, then the tileset does not subdivide further.

tileAttributes.description: A dictionary mapping tile attribute semantics to accessor indices.
tileAttributes.gltf_detailedDescription: A plain JSON object, where each key corresponds to a tile attribute semantic and each value is the index of the accessor containing attribute's data. Attribute values only exists for available tiles and are ordered by increasing tile index.

contentAttributes.description: A dictionary mapping content attribute semantics to accessor indices.
contentAttributes.gltf_detailedDescription: A plain JSON object, where each key corresponds to a content attribute semantic and each value is the index of the accessor containing attribute's data. Attribute values only exists for available contents and are ordered by increasing tile index.

tileProperties.description: Index of the property table containing tile properties.
tileProperties.gltf_detailedDescription: Index of the property table containing tile properties. Tile properties only exist for available tiles and are tightly packed by increasing tile index. To access individual tile properties, implementations may create a mapping from tile indices to tile property indices.

contentProperties.description: Index of the property table containing content properties.
contentProperties.gltf_detailedDescription: Index of the property table containing content properties. Content properties only exist for available contents and are tightly packed by increasing tile index. To access individual content properties, implementations may create a mapping from tile indices to content property indices.
